question: Q16 — the null quantile, MEASURED instead of assumed (docs/QUESTIONS.md)
notes: Every batch so far had to estimate the (1-alpha/K) null quantile parametrically because it ran too few nulls to observe that tail directly. K=6 needs ~120 nulls; this runs 300. Its purpose is to replace an ASSUMPTION (null expectancies are roughly normal) with a MEASUREMENT, and to say whether the parametric figure was too strict or too loose. That matters because the parametric bar is what every future batch will be graded against.
